observations.behavior: Replaces the inline escape-key handler and portal-creation with a dedicated SettingsDialogFrame component, removing the window.addEventListener and the portal-creation from SettingsDialog and SettingsLayout.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a reusable, accessible settings dialog shell with escape handling and portal mounting, replacing the ad-hoc implementation in SettingsDialog and SettingsLayout.

observations.behavior: Adds an Appearance settings page and its icon to the settings sidebar, and its entry in the page definitions.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a new settings category, expanding the settings surface area for users.

observations.behavior: Adds the PaintBrush icon to the App sidebar group, and the X icon to the imports, while removing the UserAvatar and authentication-dependent UI, and replacing the close button with a Back button when onBack is supplied.
observations.posthog_connection: Replaces the authentication-dependent user avatar and the generic close button with a Back button, removing the need for authentication and the UserAvatar component, and supporting a nested settings page back navigation.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the Mission Control client, the ThemePicker component, or the desktop-specific host capabilities. It only shows the removal of these dependencies from GeneralSettings and their relocation to AppearanceSettings, along with the addition of the NavRailSize store. observations.behavior: Adds a close button and its container to the SettingsPanel, while removing a ProjectSwitcher section.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the desktop settings panel's header, adding a close button and removing a project switcher. This could affect the desktop app's settings UI and potentially the user's ability to switch projects or close the settings panel.

observations.behavior: Updates a comment to clarify that the Escape key closes the dialog, not the panel.
observations.code_quote: // Escape clears the query before the dialog's hotkey can close
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies the behavior of the Escape key in the settings search input, potentially improving accessibility and user understanding of the settings panel's behavior.

observations.behavior: Adds a new useDialogFocus hook to manage focus within a dialog, including handling Tab and Shift+Tab to cycle through tabbable elements.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a new useDialogFocus hook to manage focus within a dialog, including handling Tab and Shift+Tab to cycle through tabbable elements. This could improve accessibility and user experience for keyboard navigation in the desktop app's settings panel.

observations.behavior: Adds a new settings category and its label.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a selectable option in Desktop settings; without this, the Appearance settings page would not appear. No implementation or tests are shown, so benefit is unverified.

observations.behavior: Adds a runtime check for pages whose changes reveal the app, and a helper to detect them.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the Desktop app to adjust its backdrop behavior when certain settings change. No implementation or tests are shown, so benefit is unverified.
